featured_reviews.name: Krupali Sanghavi
featured_reviews.review_text:
We ordered an engagement cake from Celejor Cakeshop for 14th Feb 2026, placing the order nearly two weeks in advance and completing both the advance and final payments on time.

Despite confirming a 6:00 PM delivery, the cake arrived about 1.5 hours late. During this time, our repeated calls went mostly unanswered or were responded to very late. This created chaos at our event and forced us to delay the cake-cutting ceremony, disturbing the flow of the evening.

The service and reliability were extremely disappointing. For an important event like an engagement, punctuality and communication are crucial.

Another major disappointment was the bride and groom figurines on the cake, which looked poorly made and completely different from what we expected. They actually looked quite odd and almost angry rather than celebratory.

I am attaching a photo of the cake — please see the picture and decide for yourself.

After raising the issue with them, the only response received was a brief apology with no real effort to address the situation.

Overall, a very stressful experience for what should have been a special moment. For an occasion as important as an engagement, reliability and professionalism matter just as much as taste, and unfortunately, that was lacking in this experience.

featured_reviews.name: elena fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely unacceptable experience with Celejor.

On 8th April, I placed an order for a 3 kg cake worth INR 4340/- and paid the full amount upfront. The order was confirmed. Shockingly, the very next day, your delivery agent collected the same payment again from our office assistant, who was unaware that the payment had already been made.

When this serious error was brought to your notice, there was ZERO accountability from your team. Instead of immediately refunding the excess amount, we were told that a refund was “not possible” and that a credit note would be issued. On what basis? Since when do customers fund your business interest-free for your mistakes?

INR 4340/- is not a negligible amount, and withholding it under the guise of a credit note is completely unacceptable and unethical.

The situation worsened when we visited your store today 24th April 2026 There was not even a basic apology or acknowledgment of the mistake. Your representative gave illogical explanations about “delivery charges,” despite full payment already being made. When asked to speak to the manager, he conveniently avoided facing us and kept us waiting with excuses like “cash shortage.” For a brand of your scale, this is beyond embarrassing.

Only after repeated pressure and multiple calls was the amount finally returned. Ironically, the manager chose to appear only after the issue was resolved, clearly avoiding responsibility.

This entire incident reflects extremely poor management, lack of integrity, and complete disregard for customers. Mistakes can happen, but refusing to correct them promptly and attempting to withhold money is unacceptable.

Customers deserve honesty, accountability, and basic respect—none of which were demonstrated here.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Serving the finest cakes at not too exorbitant price

Have tried cakes, pastries, puffs, and many other foodstuffs from merwans, but each time I try these guys become better and better. This time I had tried the half kg version of the strawberry ganache flavor and it was absolutely delicious.

The cake has three layers of cream with soft chocolate flavored bread as the base. The topmost layer on the cake is pure white cream and it does taste delicious. It has a small dollop of strawberry jam at the top and nice design of chocolate cream on one side over the white cream. the second layer is the strawberry cream mixed with vanilla as I tasted. you can feel the sweet strawberry taste mixed with vanilla and you can see the light pinkish color of the cream.

The third layer has pure chocolate cream and you either eat all the three one at a time or at once each way you get a unique taste and that taste of the cream melting in your mouth. All in all, this was a wonderful flavor and truly loved the taste of the cake.

7th June was my dad’s 54th birthday, and I wanted to surprise him with a cake that truly matched his personality.

Since Black Forest has been his favorite flavor since childhood, I was specifically looking for a fondant cake in that flavor.

Unfortunately, a nearby cake shop declined my request.

I decided to try my luck and gave Ribbon & balloons a call.

It was already around 6:00 PM on Saturday, and I needed the cake by Sunday morning.

Mr. Moin patiently understood all my requirements and assured me that they could make it happen.

I was so happy when I received the cake! It looked exactly how I had imagined.

The cake topper, sprinkles, and all the decorative elements were safely packed in a separate box, showing great attention to detail.

The staff was extremely helpful and courteous throughout the process. To top it all off, I got this customized cake for under ₹1,300, whereas other shops had quoted me ₹1,600–₹1,700 for a similar design.

The cake tasted delicious, looked amazing, and made my dad’s birthday extra special.

Thank you, Mr. Moin and the entire team, for going the extra mile. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.review_text:
There are no photos attached because I devoured everything before getting a chance to click any pictures.
I ordered a few items from cake baking engineered and the only bad thing about them is the wait time, which is completely understandable as everything is made to order. I would definitely recommend this to anyone as none of the items we ordered was upto the mark. Everything was fresh and lovely. We ordered a Strawberry cake, fudgy brownies and some choco chunk cookies. We had to wait around 4 hours for everything to be prepared but it was definitely worth the wait.
1. Strawberry Cake  4.5⭐
The cake was filled with fresh strawberries and was super moist. The cream used was fresh although stealing a bit of flavour from the cake. The price of 550 makes it a bit pricey, but the quality is unparalleled. Definitely would recommend.
2. Choco Chunk Cookies  4⭐
These cookies were as big as the palm of my hands and had an amazing quantity of chocolate chunks that perfectly satisfied my cravings. 0.5 were cut because the cookie dough overpowered the chocolate used. The chocolate chunks therefore lacked character and were not those bombs of chocolate I was expecting. Another 0.5 were cut because of my personal preferences of having a bit of salt in my cookies. I'm pretty sure Pinaz would have accommodated my reservations, but it was lacking this time.
3. Fudgy Brownies  5⭐
Definitely the star of the show. The brownies were exactly what I was expecting. It was gooey and chocolatey, were extremely fresh and had a crusty top. No issues whatsoever and definitely stands up to it's name.

I would absolutely recommend Cake Baking Engineered to everyone with a sweet tooth. Pinaz definitely delivers her attention and love to each and every product.
